description.value: A prospective, community-based study evaluating FDG-PET diagnostic accuracy for differential diagnosis of early-onset dementia.

spans.text: The aim of this study was to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of positron emission tomography (PET) using F fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the differential diagnosis of early-onset Alzheimer's disease (AD) and other dementias in a community-dwelling population.
A prospective sample of 102 individuals presenting consecutively to a primary care centre for examination of suspected early-onset dementing diseases.
